data.title: Foodex Saudi to Open in Jeddah Monday with Over 800 Brands
data.content:
Jeddah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The 14th edition of Foodex Saudi, Saudi Arabia's leading international food and beverage exhibition, will open Monday at the Jeddah Chamber's Jeddah Center for Exhibitions and Events (JCEE).
    The three-day event will bring together manufacturers and suppliers from more than 50 countries. It will showcase the latest food products and technologies, facilitate the exchange of expertise, and help build strategic business partnerships in the region's largest food market.
    The exhibition is expected to attract more than 20,000 visitors and trade buyers and feature over 800 brands and international exhibitors. Around 200 professional chefs will also participate in competitions held alongside the event.
    Foodex Saudi will offer a dedicated business matchmaking program, allowing decision-makers, businesspeople, and executives to schedule meetings with exhibiting companies in advance. The program aims to help participants make the most of their visits and conduct business more efficiently.
    It will give visitors and buyers access to leading local and international suppliers across various food sectors. Participants can arrange meetings in advance, save time and effort, and connect directly with exhibitors. The program will also allow exhibitors to meet prospective clients, expand their businesses, and build relationships with leading corporate buyers from local and regional markets.
    The exhibition will also host the Saudi Culinary Challenge 2026 under the theme "Discovering the Chefs of Tomorrow." Billed as Saudi Arabia's largest international competition for professional chefs, it will bring together around 200 Saudi and expatriate chefs representing leading hotels and restaurants from cities across the Kingdom. They will compete in 17 categories in a professional setting.
    -- SPA
